description.text: Europe's leading earliest-stage venture capitalist. Based in Berlin, we support ambitious founding teams with pre-seed funding and long-term partnership.

targetApplicants.text: Based in Berlin and backed by Axel Springer and Porsche, we support and partner with the most ambitious pre-seed startups from Europe and beyond – often as their first investor.

sources.quote: APX - Earliest-stage startup investor. VC in Berlin. Raphael and Christian develop a “do-it-yourself investment software”. Emmora Evgeniya and Victoria digitize the funeral industry to give the best farewell. Offmade Lucas and Lennart create the digital investment real estate platform. Unown Tina and Linda make premium, sustainable fashion leasable online. Based in Berlin and backed by Axel Springer and Porsche, we support and partner with the most ambitious pre-seed startups from Europe and beyond – often as their first investor.
